bank: Livehouse Duel P2 original procedural arcade effects

provenance.authoring: Original procedural synthesis authored by OpenAI assistant for this game project.
provenance.source_inputs: Numeric synthesis parameters and deterministic xorshift32 noise only. No recordings, libraries of sound samples, commercial-game extraction, or third-party audio inputs.
provenance.third_party_audio_license: Not applicable to generated P2 samples; existing separately licensed CC0 cat recording is untouched.
provenance.reproduction: Python 3.12.14 + NumPy 2.3.5 reference environment; deterministic source, seeds, PCM and SHA-256 checks. Floating-point libraries can affect exact bytes on other architectures; --check detects differences.
provenance.listening: Not subjectively auditioned. Numeric waveform, spectrum, headroom and byte checks do not certify perceptual quality or phone playback.

runtime_contract.import_policy: Lossless PCM (compress/mode=0), no normalize, no trim, no loop, no forced resample; source WAV numeric budget assumes no lossy transform.
runtime_contract.recommended_variant_policy: Alternate or bounded random choice; do not play both variants for one event.
runtime_contract.gate_policy: One cue per accepted event, mute/pause/background/menu stop all voices, user-input audio unlock, no BGM.

band_energy_method: Whole-file one-sided rFFT power normalized to unit energy; half-open frequency intervals, including Nyquist. Phone-band metric is a spectral proxy, not perceptual certification.
